From f62a218a946b19bb59abdd5361da85fa4606b96b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:48:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] netfilter: xt_CT: drop pending enqueued packets on template
 removal

Templates refer to objects that can go away while packets are sitting in
nfqueue refer to:

- helper, this can be an issue on module removal.
- timeout policy, nfnetlink_cttimeout might remove it.

The use of templates with zone and event cache filter are safe, since
this just copies values.

Flush these enqueued packets in case the template rule gets removed.

Fixes: 24de58f46516 ("netfilter: xt_CT: allow to attach timeout policy + glue code")
Reported-by: Yiming Qian <yimingqian591@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>

diff --git a/net/netfilter/xt_CT.c b/net/netfilter/xt_CT.c
index 3ba94c34297c..498f5871c84a 100644
--- a/net/netfilter/xt_CT.c
+++ b/net/netfilter/xt_CT.c
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@
 #include <net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_ecache.h>
 #include <net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_timeout.h>
 #include <net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_zones.h>
+#include "nf_internals.h"
 
 static inline int xt_ct_target(struct sk_buff *skb, struct nf_conn *ct)
 {
@@ -283,6 +284,9 @@ static void xt_ct_tg_destroy(const struct xt_tgdtor_param *par,
 	struct nf_conn_help *help;
 
 	if (ct) {
+		if (info->helper[0] || info->timeout[0])
+			nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(par->net);
+
 		help = nfct_help(ct);
 		xt_ct_put_helper(help);
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file (`net/netfilter/xt_CT.c`) with two changes:

1. **Added include**: `#include "nf_internals.h"` to gain access to the `nf_queue_nf_hook_drop()` function.

2. **Added call in `xt_ct_tg_destroy`**: Before destroying the conntrack template, if `info->helper[0]` or `info->timeout[0]` is non‑empty, the function now invokes `nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(par->net)`. This drops any packets still pending in the nfqueue that reference the helper or timeout policy, preventing use‑after‑free when those objects are removed.

**Relationship**:  
The new include provides the prototype for `nf_queue_nf_hook_drop()`, which is then called under specific conditions (when a helper or timeout policy is present) to flush enqueued packets before the referenced objects are cleaned up. This ensures that template removal safely handles pending packets that rely on the helper or timeout policy.

Here is the commit message:
netfilter: xt_CT: drop pending enqueued packets on template
 removal

Templates refer to objects that can go away while packets are sitting in
nfqueue refer to:

- helper, this can be an issue on module removal.
- timeout policy, nfnetlink_cttimeout might remove it.

The use of templates with zone and event cache filter are safe, since
this just copies values.

Flush these enqueued packets in case the template rule gets removed.

Fixes: 24de58f46516 ("netfilter: xt_CT: allow to attach timeout policy + glue code")
Reported-by: Yiming Qian <yimingqian591@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>

Here is the root cause:
When a conntrack template created by xt_CT with a helper or timeout policy is removed, pending packets in nfqueue that reference those objects are not flushed, causing use-after-free when the helper module or timeout policy is subsequently unloaded or removed.

Here is the patch:
 #include <net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_timeout.h>
 #include <net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_zones.h>
+#include "nf_internals.h"
 
 static inline int xt_ct_target(struct sk_buff *skb, struct nf_conn *ct)
 
 static void xt_ct_tg_destroy(const struct xt_tgdtor_param *par,
 			     struct xt_ct_target_info_v1 *info)
 {
 	struct nf_conn *ct = info->ct;
 	struct nf_conn_help *help;
 
 	if (ct) {
+		if (info->helper[0] || info->timeout[0])
+			nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(par->net);
+
 		help = nfct_help(ct);
 		xt_ct_put_helper(help);
 
 		nf_ct_netns_put(par->net, par->family);
 
 		nf_ct_destroy_timeout(ct);
 		nf_ct_put(info->ct);
 	}
 }
